text:
lina_platform: quick sync 11 I prototyped a lightweight rollout API for runtime flags so console flips are auditable and reversible. Pushed schema + example to staging.

ryan_dev: nice. what's the default policy for flags that touch routing or quota? we shouldn't let product flip those without safeguards.

lina_platform: default = 'canary' with these constraints: 1) max 1% traffic initially, 2) required telemetry probe attached, 3) owner metadata required. Full promote must be explicit.

neha_sre: please add a dependent-resource scan in the API that returns any quotas, GPU reservations, or I/O knobs referenced by the flag. We need a pre-flight warning for capacity storms.

todd_prod: also useful: a quick impact estimate for cost delta if the flag increases token ceiling. Not exact but ballpark.

lina_platform: added a micro-sim that replays last 7d traffic and projects spend delta and 95p load. output shown inline in the rollout modal.

ryan_dev: example request/response for the API?

lina_platform: paste: 

```
POST /api/v1/rollouts
{
  "flag_key": "route.max_tokens",
  "value": 8192,
  "policy": {
    "mode": "canary",
    "initial_sampling": 0.01,
    "auto_pause_thresholds": {"latency_ms": 50, "error_pct": 0.5}
  },
  "owner": "ryan_dev",
  "notes": "increase for beta partners"
}

Response 202 -> rollout_id
```

neha_sre: good. for auto_pause_thresholds we prefer SLO-relative thresholds instead of raw ms/pct (e.g., +10% relative to baseline). Less brittle across regions.

lina_platform: agreed. switching to relative deltas. also added `snooze_until` for scheduled promotes (useful for timezone ops).

opsbot: opsbot: rollout created: id=roll-20260321-9, owner=ryan_dev, mode=canary(1%). Runbook: /runbooks/rollout-default.

ryan_dev: Can the API mark a rollout as "review required" when the dependent-resource scan finds more than one impacted quota? We want a human approval gate.

lina_platform: yes. New state=REVIEW_REQUIRED. The console will show approvers based on ACL rules.

neha_sre: On approvals: require at least one SRE and one Product approver for >5% impact changes or any change that touches model-routing keys.

todd_prod: make sure ACL resolution is visible in the modal before submit so owners can plan approvals.

lina_platform: UX note: we're adding a tiny diff view showing the exact config path and constraints. Also a timeline widget: created -> canary -> staged -> promote. Each transition logs actor and snapshot.

ryan_dev: rollback path? sometimes we need a fast revert.

lina_platform: two fast paths: 1) emergency revert button (reapplies previous snapshot) with audit and optional postmortem trigger, 2) automated revert when auto_pause fires. Both create a revert-event and alert the owner + SRE on-call.

neha_sre: For automated revert, add an option to pin a mitigation route (e.g., fall back to smaller model) so traffic doesn't entirely stop.

lina_platform: added `fallback_action` enum: {NONE, REDIRECT_TO_LEGACY, SWITCH_MODEL_VARIANT}. Defaults to NONE.

opsbot: opsbot: smoke tests started for /smoke/rollout-api (canary path, approval flows, audit log).

ryan_dev: tiny thought: enable an optional "annotation" field that surfaces in alerts and runbook preface so responders know intent. e.g., "beta for partner X, expected higher token usage but ok".

lina_platform: done. free-text annotation stored with rollout snapshot and included in alert payloads.

neha_sre: last ask: telemetry requirement should be pluggable. Some flags need custom metrics; console should surface the recommended probes and let you attach them. If none exist, show suggested probe templates.

lina_platform: prototype shows recommended probes based on flag tag heuristics (routing, quota, model). We'll add templates for common checks (latency, 5xx, tail-p99 tokens, cost delta).

ryan_dev: timeline for enabling for prod?

lina_platform: planning to enable read-only in prod this week, and canary-create guarded behind an ACL toggle next week after approvals.

opsbot: opsbot: deployment v2.0.3 succeeded to staging. Verify: rollout-create, dependent-scan, approval-state machine.

neha_sre: I'll run manual integration tests and exercise approval flows with simulated quotas. Will report back by EOD.

ryan_dev: thanks, team. if Neha gives thumbs up, can we greenlight the ACL toggle?

lina_platform: yes. I'll draft a short blurb for #eng-announce and a one-pager for SRE runbook updates.

ryan_dev: Also add an inline coachmark in console about "Why we require telemetry for canary" for new users.

lina_platform: on the list. :white_check_mark:
